text:
maria-ops: Quick heads-up — proposing a staged unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 2.15 for eu-west tonight. Target window 23:00-01:00 UTC, staggered to ap-south +3h. Reason: perf win for longseq and kernel fixes. We hit an SDK signature mismatch on mobile sdk@2.3 that prevents automatic client routing unless we apply the shim. Need ack from platform + QA.

deploybot: [automated] scheduled change draft created: unpin runtime-2.14 for model-group A, canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 60m. Will block if telemetry error_rate > 1.5% or p95 latency regression > 25%.

ajenkins: Are we publishing release notes for customers? also post the rollback command in the runbook plz. If mobile sdk is mismatched, can we gate by header-based routing to avoid mobile traffic?

leo-platform: Telemetry note — our longseq quantized probes show median token latency -2ms on 2.15 but p75 spikes up to +120ms in eu-west under 64k sequence synthetic load. Canary to start 1% is safe. Recommend keep canary at 1% for 30m and inspect kcache hit rate + kernel OOM logs.

sasha: +1 on the canary. Suggest we add a quick AB test label to route only server-side traffic for first stage (no mobile) until sdk@2.3 shim is rolled. Also ask devex to update SDK compat table in release notes.

maria-ops: Plan:
- 23:00 UTC eu-west canary 1% (server-only) for 30m
- 23:30 increase to 10% (all traffic except mobile) for 20m
- 23:50 roll to 50% if no alerts, then 100% next-hour window if stable
Rollback runbook snippet:
```
# emergency rollback
deploybot revert --runtime runtime-2.14 --group model-group-A --reason "canary failure"
# or via API
curl -X POST https://internal-deploy/revert \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"runtime":"runtime-2.14","group":"model-group-A"}'
```
Also tagging @qa-bot to run the nightly regression suite against canary endpoints (longseq, repeated-token sampling, kv cache integrity).

qa-bot: queued: nightly-regressions -> will run shortly and post results in #eng-qa. Failures will add a rollback signal to deploybot.

deploybot: [automated] change scheduled: eu-west 2024-04-12T23:00Z. Canary policy: 1% x30m (server-only). Auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate>1.5% OR failed_regressions>3 OR p95_latency_increase>25%. Will emit progress updates here.

ajenkins: Approving — leaving a note to docs team to add compat blurb re: mobile sdk 2.3 shim. :+1:

leo-platform: I'll watch telemetry and post early warning if p75/p95 trends up. If we see kvcache miss rate spike >5% we'll abort.

sasha: tagging devex to patch SDK table and include the shim steps.

maria-ops: Thanks — proceeding with scheduled canary. Will post deploybot updates and final release-note blurb after canary.

deploybot: [automated] canary started: eu-west model-group-A 1% (server-only). Canaries: 0m elapsed. Monitoring hooks active.
